investment.heroSubtitle: Tangible real estate assets with strong use value, driven by structural demand.
investment.conceptP1: I-CA.RE acquires undervalued urban ground floors (50 to 300 sqm) and transforms them into next-generation care and wellbeing spaces.
investment.conceptP2: Each asset ranges from 50 to 300 sqm, with an optimised common-area ratio that enhances circulation and shared use. Private offices, typically 11 to 15 sqm, can be custom-designed to meet the specific needs of each professional. The granular multi-tenant structure structurally reduces vacancy risk.
investment.executionModelDesc: A responsible, long-term stewardship approach founded on utility, asset quality and sustainable management.
investment.pillar1Desc: Care and wellbeing spaces, in the heart of communities, meeting structural demand. Practitioner stability and continuity of care.
investment.pillar2Desc: Rigorous location selection, full renovation, regulatory compliance and energy performance.
investment.pillar3Desc: Demanding operations, preventive maintenance, practitioner community facilitation and continuous improvement of spaces.
investment.forInvestorsP1: I-CA.RE is a family-backed private real estate company that structures care and wellbeing operations with an entrepreneurial model. The investor contributes capital; I-CA.RE contributes the full operational capability: development, engineering, construction, leasing and asset stewardship.
investment.forInvestorsP2: Detailed financial terms, scenarios and assumptions are shared upon qualification through the form.

items.quote: I now practise within an I-CA.RE space and have found a setting that is both professional and deeply human. The fit-out is of high quality: renovation, acoustics, comfort, and a soothing atmosphere that genuinely supports the therapeutic alliance. The space allows me to welcome patients in the right conditions, with a real sense of confidentiality and safety. Day to day, the environment is respectful and warm, which has a concrete positive impact on my practice and on the quality of welcome I can offer.

approach.heroTitle: Spaces designed for care, built to last
approach.heroP1: I-CA.RE was born from a simple conviction: care and wellbeing professions deserve spaces genuinely adapted to their human, relational and professional demands.
approach.heroP2: Confidentiality, acoustic quality, comfort, professional image, patient welcome — these dimensions cannot be improvised. They must be considered from the very design of the space.
approach.heroP3: We transform urban ground floors into workspaces suited to contemporary therapeutic practices, reconciling architectural rigour with a deep understanding of usage.
approach.foundersTitle: A vision driven by two complementary expertises
approach.foundersIntro: I-CA.RE is an independent, family-backed property company. It draws on the convergence of care expertise and proven real estate and technical mastery.
approach.jazminP1: A brief-therapy practitioner based in Bordeaux, Jazmin supports adults and adolescents around issues related to body image, eating, self-esteem and eating disorders.
approach.jazminP2: Her approach is integrative and humanistic. She pays particular attention to the quality of the therapeutic relationship, emotional safety and the setting in which care takes place.
approach.jazminP3: Her daily experience of clinical practice directly shapes the design of I-CA.RE spaces: a calming atmosphere, respect for confidentiality, acoustic quality, and a balance between intimacy and openness.
approach.nicolasP1: A real-estate entrepreneur and managing director of Rivage Ingénierie & Construction, Nicolas develops and manages urban asset requalification projects.
approach.nicolasP2: His expertise spans design, technical mastery, refurbishment and regulatory compliance for buildings open to the public.
approach.nicolasP3: Within I-CA.RE, he ensures architectural quality, real acoustic performance, regulatory compliance and the long-term durability of assets.
approach.nicolasP4: Every space is designed with the same standard: stability, coherence and durability.
approach.synthesisP1: Every I-CA.RE space is designed at the intersection of two realities:
approach.synthesisBullet2: The technical and urban constraints of real estate
approach.synthesisP2: We develop our assets progressively and with control, paying particular attention to local roots and quality of use.
approach.synthesisP3: Our ambition is not rapid growth, but the lasting creation of professional spaces suited to care and wellbeing professions.
approach.ctaTitle: Want to contribute to this vision?
approach.ctaDesc: Whether you are a care or wellbeing practitioner, a local authority or an investor, join us in this mission.
